description: Reply asks for both a referral and records. Blocking item is the referral (nothing else can proceed without it), so class is needs_referral; records are secondary.

event.subject: Re: Request for appointment
event.body:
Hello,

We need two things. First, a referral from your treating physician is required before we can open a new-patient file. Second, once that is in place please send your recent imaging reports. We cannot book until the referral arrives.

Crestline Intake Team

expected.rationale: A referral is required before booking, and it blocks the records step, so referral comes first.
expected.quote: a referral from your treating physician is required before we can open a new-patient file
